analysis.reasoning_summary: The entry risk plan defined invalidation explicitly: a heavy-volume break of $183.39/$183 confirming a bearish move toward $164-167. That exact condition fired on the entry session itself (fill 209.55 = the 2026-10-06 open): the stock spiked to 219.71, then collapsed through $183 on 8.56M shares — roughly 3x the recent ~2-3.2M average — closing at 166.97, inside the stated bear target. The following session gapped down further and closed at 155.65, ~25.7% below the 209.55 entry and below both the original $183 intraday stop and the $164 close-below stop recorded in position state. The bear case is realized, not merely threatened; none of the reevaluation catalysts (confirmed lockup absorption, DeepMind economics disclosure, a second consecutive cash-flow-positive quarter) have occurred, and the volume signature is consistent with the lockup-supply distribution the risk plan flagged. Remaining upside to the entry thesis is gone — the $164-167 breakdown zone is now resistance — while downside momentum is unresolved, so reward/risk no longer justifies deployment. Exit all 11 shares; no partial exit or tightened stop substitutes for the invalidated thesis.
